title: High NA EUV: How a new generation of lithography is ready to shape our future

passages.note: The start of the EUV era and The next big thing: High NA EUV. The receiving lab recalls its 2006 tool, commercial EUV readiness around 2019, and the complementary 0.55 NA platform at the same wavelength. Imec specifies changes to optics, photoresist, etch, and metrology. The 2024 Veldhoven work demonstrated patterning with the new system.
